digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview/sync and reconcile command
propositions: Canonical preview must execute a single ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit one manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift detail from that same pass without re-invoking reconcile-check
Canonical preview must remain lock-free and not acquire, purge, steal, or write pass locks, leaving unrelated ticket/binding/snapshot/diagnostic/lock state unchanged
Legacy reconcile-check mode must retain its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair behavior, diagnostic JSON artifact, and independent lock-free execution contract

The argparse parser must use allow_abbrev=False to reject undocumented prefix abbreviations like --dry-run before any repository or lock access, while preserving documented legacy --mode dry-run as valid

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope, while legacy uncapped live callers through all surfaces (CLI/library/MCP/workflows) retain the historical tally-without-retained-manifest contract
Capped canonical sync and legacy bootstrap applied/deferred partitions must remain deterministic and unchanged
